_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values.
_comment_windows: On Windows use full paths, e.g. C:\Program Files\Calibre2\calibredb.exe

ai._comment: Anthropic-only. Set api_key once here (or via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var). Per-command blocks only need a model — they inherit the top-level api_key. Add api_key to a per-command block only if you want a different key for that command.

identifiers._comment_fetch: Leave blank to auto-detect from calibredb_path. On Windows set to e.g. C:\Program Files\Calibre2\fetch-ebook-metadata.exe
identifiers._comment_workers: Concurrent fetch-ebook-metadata calls during MQG-02. Each call is mostly network I/O so threading gives real speedup; 3–5 is a sane range. Drop to 1 to serialise.
identifiers._comment_sufficient: A book is considered already sufficient if it has at least one of these identifier types. Sufficient books skip the live lookup.
identifiers._comment_mqg_complete: Extra identifier types that must be present before MQG-02 is marked complete. Books enriched but missing these are reported as 'pending ratings' and not marked done. Set to [] to disable the gate.

lcc._comment: MQG-03 LCC enrichment — custom column labels (with leading #).

comments._comment: MQG-04 comments enrichment — custom column labels.

tags._comment: MQG-05 tag enrichment and review settings.
